text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Look over here next, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is speaking to the press
today. She doesn't exactly go out of her
way to give
interviews ordinarily, so a lot
of journalists have gathered for the
opportunity—just as she said they would.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given that the particular purpose of
today's gathering is a photo shoot
featuring her signature
racewear, most
questions revolve around that.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
If I were to describe my impression of
your racewear in a word, I'd call it
"sharp." Would you
say this reflects your
personal tastes?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It depends on your definition of sharp. But as for whether or not it suits my tastes, I'd say it does, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Does your signature racewear represent
your
typical fashion sense?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I believe I just said it matches my
personal tastes.
Next question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur continues to answer calmly,
and the
interview proceeds without a
hitch, until out of
nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to ask your trainer a question,
if I
may.

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'd like to hear your thoughts on Air
Shakur's
signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Would it be fair to take your use of the

superlative as a direct comparison to the
other
runners?
choice_data_list: I think that's very like her.

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur. What do you make of your
trainer's
statement?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This is hardly the first time my trainer
has gotten
carried away with clear bias. I
honestly could not
care less.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But even a broken clock is correct twice a day. I am the coolest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The interview continues smoothly after
that,
until...

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text: Could you give an example of how?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has always had a very striking

appearance. But that doesn't mean the
racewear
detracts from it in any way.
choice_data_list: The way it harmonizes with her ind...

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
I see what you mean! It certainly does
enhance Air
Shakur's natural glamour.
choice_data_list: I believe we're showcasing an appe...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Glamour?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The interview continues smoothly after
that,
until...

text_block_list.name: Reporter F
text_block_list.text:
What would you say you were most
particular
about in the design?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The level of care Air Shakur put into
designing
her signature racewear was
something to behold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She started by seeking a trustworthy
designer, then fussing over the materials
and ironing out the cleat design in
meticulous detail. She was fully engaged
throughout the entire process.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A truly beautiful program is one that
functions
without drawing attention to
itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the calculated trim of the fabric to
the asymmetrical scarf at her waist...
There are
countless things she might
mention.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What was I particular about?
Well...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Isn't that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Reporter F
text_block_list.text: Erm? Miss Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur slips away from the reporters
and steps
up to the starting position on
the track.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She explodes forward as if a starting gun
has sounded, the waist scarf billowing
behind her as
she speeds around the
track.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
...Holy cow!
She's captivating! Tell me
you're getting this!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I believe that answers the last question.
That'll do
for today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter F
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Sorry, but you haven't actually
answered
yet!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I showed you my answer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm going ahead. Wrap this up however
you like.

text_block_list.name: Reporter F
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer. What just happened?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't tell lies, so she must have
already laid out the intermediate steps
required to find the
solution. As long as I
realize that much, I should be able to
solve the problem...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A truly beautiful program is one that
functions
without drawing attention to
itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has demonstrated her program in
action, directing everyone's
eyes to herself as she
ran, and nothing
else.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
The hell's up with this article?
choice_data_list: If I had to guess, the answer is—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Each and every fiber in the body has a numerical value, and the intricate equation woven out of them produces one simple result: running."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's highlighting her
eccentricity in the paddock or her
razor-sharp grace on the track—her
signature racewear is just the suit for
the job."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What's with this exaggerated hype job? I didn't say any of this crap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: But your running *proved* it, I te...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're so dumb.
Quit actin' like you get
anything.
